activity_statements.statement: operates one of the world's largest online retail marketplaces offering hundreds of millions of products to consumers and third-party sellers globally
runs AWS, the world's most broadly adopted cloud platform, serving millions of enterprise, startup, and government customers with compute, storage, AI, and managed services
designs and manufactures custom silicon chips (Trainium for AI training, Graviton for general compute) for cloud and AI workloads, exceeding a $25B annual revenue run rate
produces and distributes streaming entertainment through Prime Video, Amazon MGM Studios, MGM+, Amazon Music, Audible, Amazon Games, and Twitch
operates Amazon Pharmacy and Amazon One Medical to provide prescription fulfillment and primary care services to consumers
runs a global fulfillment and delivery network with AI-driven robotics, 25,000+ Amazon Locker pickup locations, and expanding Prime Air drone delivery
sells digital advertising to brands seeking access to Amazon's shopping audience, generating $19.8B in Q2 revenue, up 26% year-over-year
develops Alexa AI assistants and a constellation of consumer electronic devices (Echo, Fire TV, Kindle, Ring) for the smart home and entertainment markets

name_reality_gap: Amazon is classified as 'Software Development' by best-places-to-work indexes, and to many connotes online shopping — but the activity evidence shows a conglomerate spanning cloud infrastructure (AWS, the largest profit center), custom chip manufacturing, an ad network, streaming studios, primary care clinics, and a physical fulfillment/delivery operation employing hundreds of thousands of warehouse workers.
extraction_notes: Strong sources available. Revenue segment weights are estimates based on published Q2 2026 data referenced in news articles on amazon.com/about page.
